description: This file contains unit tests for the SocialCommitment model class, including tests for creation, validation, icon handling, SDG relationships, deletion, and cleanup within the Goteo project.

classes.name: SocialCommitmentTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the SocialCommitment model, covering creation, validation, icon management, SDG relations, and deletion.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the SocialCommitment class.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Validates the SocialCommitment instance; expects validation to fail with current data.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates a new SocialCommitment and verifies it is saved correctly.

methods.name: testIcon
methods.description: Tests icon association and link generation for SocialCommitment.

methods.name: testSdgRelationships
methods.description: Tests associating, replacing, and retrieving SDGs related to the SocialCommitment.

methods.name: testRemoveSdgRelationships
methods.description: Tests removal of SDG relationships from the SocialCommitment.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of the SocialCommitment from the database.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Verifies that a deleted SocialCommitment cannot be retrieved.
